title: You Don't Have to Have It All Figured Out

paragraphs: Good morning, and welcome to a new week.
There is something quietly reassuring about remembering that we don't need to have every answer before taking the next step.
Some days, progress looks like a big achievement. Other days, it's simply making a decision, trying again, or finding the courage to begin something we've been putting off.
As Martin Luther King Jr. reminded us:
“Faith is taking the first step even when you don't see the whole staircase.”
Whatever this week holds, give yourself permission to move forward without having everything figured out.
You don't need to see the entire journey to take one meaningful step today.
A new week. A fresh opportunity. Your next step is enough.
